messages:
harper: Quick postmortem follow-up from the auth-service incident. Two repeat patterns: short flapping spikes (~1-4m) that cause noisy pages, and separate slow ramp-ups (>10m) we sometimes miss until SLA breach. Need clear owners and a tracker so this doesn't keep recurring.

harper: Suggested actions:
1) Hysteresis + backoff on auth-timeout alert to avoid paging for micro-spikes.
2) Dedupe window increase for auth-timeout + fingerprint by trace_id/session.
3) Fast-path rule: if sustained error_rate > 3% for 8m, bypass dedupe and escalate.
4) Quiet-mute for non-prod routes during 22:30-07:00 local.
5) Runbook update with rollback + CI smoke job spec.

miho: I can take #1. Proposal: require p99 > 650ms for 3/5 5m windows before paging. I'll run a backtest on the last 21 days and post graphs. ETA: 24h.

noah: I'll own #2 and #3. Current dedupe is 90s; suggest 6m for auth-timeout fingerprinted by trace_id. For the bypass, add an immediate rule if errors > 3% for 8m. I'll include label exclude for internal-bot traces. ETA: 48h.

synth-bot: Created ticket: SRE-9102 "auth alert hysteresis + dedupe + bypass" assigned to noah.

oscar: I'll add #4 quiet-mute for non-prod routes and add DST-safe times. ETA: 3h.

lina: I'll update the runbook and draft a k6 job for CI smoke that simulates bursty traffic; will include minimal verification steps and a rollback checklist. Runbook PR by EOD, CI spec in 48h.

harper: Good. Please add PR/ticket links in the tracker. Also decision: keep a short noisy-alert metric for ML-scorer later. Add as follow-up item in tracker.

miho: Backtest query I'll use: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(auth_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))`  will paste graphs in tracker.

noah: Note: when fingerprinting, confirm traces aren't sampled out; fallback to session_id. I'll add that as a requirement in PR.

oscar: Quiet-mute PR: https://redwood/repo/alerts/pull/2098 (will merge after ops review).

synth-bot: Tracker updated: https://redwood/pm/trackers/pm-auth-2555 (items seeded: SRE-9102).

harper: Owners recap: miho=#1 (24h), noah=#2,#3 (48h), oscar=#4 (3h), lina=#5 (EOD/48h). Reconvene in 48h in-thread for status. If anyone needs to swap ping me directly. :thumbsup:

lina: Added runbook stub and CI spec link in tracker. PR: https://redwood/docs/runbooks/pull/145

miho: Will post backtest screenshots and recommended final threshold in the tracker.

noah: Will open alert config PR and include the dedupe + bypass rules for review.

harper: Thanks all. Let's aim to close these in the sprint.
